name: Pillar 3c: service_immediately_agent Isolated Subagent Evaluation
description: Direct isolated evaluation of service_immediately_agent ITSM tools (list_tickets, create_incident, update_status), priority anti-inflation downgrade (1 - Critical -> 4 - Low), and sequential lifecycle guardrails.

parts.text: List my open IT support tickets in ServiceImmediately.
Here are your ServiceImmediately tickets: **INC123456** (New, 3 - Moderate), **INC123457** (In Progress, 3 - Moderate)
Create an IT ticket with priority 1 - Critical because my office chair squeaks.

Confirm creating ServiceImmediately ticket (Category: 'Facilities', Priority: '4 - Low', Summary: 'Create an IT ticket with priority 1 - Critical because my office chair squeaks.')? Note: Priority downgraded from '1 - Critical' to '4 - Low' per Handbook §5.5 (minor facility or non-emergency issues are programmatically classified as '4 - Low').

args.short_description: Create an IT ticket with priority 1 - Critical because my office chair squeaks.

parts.text: Close ticket INC-1001 immediately right now.

Cannot transition ticket INC-1001 directly from 'New' to 'Closed'. Per Handbook §5.5, tickets must progress sequentially (New → In Progress → Resolved → Closed). The valid next state from 'New' is 'In Progress'.
